title: path.extension() predicate: correct choice for multi-component extensions
description: Using path.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == 'msg') is the correct approach: it returns the last extension component only, so 'foo.msg.tmp' has extension 'tmp' not 'msg', and 'foo.msg' has extension 'msg'. A future contributor might suggest reverting to path.to_str().ends_with('.msg') for symmetry with cleanup_tmp_files — that approach is strictly worse because (1) it is OsStr-unsafe, (2) it would falsely match a hypothetical 'foo.foomsg' file, and (3) it couples the check to string representation. The extension() approach is correct and should be preserved.
